title: Material basis and action mechanism of Euryale Ferox Salisb in preventing and treating diabetic kidney disease.
authors: Li, Jun; Yang, Kaiping; Guo, Yunhui; Cao, Lukang; Cheng, Fangling; Zhang, Nannan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究芡实治疗糖尿病肾病的成分与靶点，虽涉及转录因子预测和分子对接，但核心是药物-疾病靶点而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The aim of this study was to determine the chemical structure and mechanism of action of Euryale ferox Salisb (ES) in the prevention and treatment of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). The TCMSP, SymMap V2, CTD, DisGeNET, and GeneCards databases were searched for ES components, targets, and DKD targets using the network pharmacology method to identify common drug-disease targets. PPI analysis was used to identify hub genes, which were then followed by DKD clinical relevance, GO, KEGG analysis, and transcription factor prediction. Finally, molecular docking was performed. We discovered 24 components of ES and 72 objectives of ES, 9 of which were clinically relevant and primarily regulated by transcription factors such as HNF4A and PPARG. They are involved primarily in signal transduction, inflammatory responses, TNF regulation, apoptosis, MAPK, and other signaling pathways. The main components are oleic acid targeting the protein encoded by PPARA, LPL, FABP1, and vitamin E binding the protein encoded by MAPK1, TGFB1. In general, this approach provides an effective strategy in which ES acts primarily against DKD through oleic acid and vitamin E, targeting the protein encoded by PPARA, LPL, FABP1, MAPK1 to regulate TNF, apoptosis, MAPK, and other signaling pathways. PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS: Euryale ferox Salisb (ES) is well known for its use in medicine and food. Furthermore, ES contains many nutrients, whose pharmacological properties, including antidepressant, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic action, have been extensively demonstrated by numerous studies. In this article, through network pharmacology combined with clinical correlation analysis and molecular docking, the target and mechanism of ES in the treatment of diabetic kidney disease (DKD) were discussed, which clarified its mechanism at the molecular level. Provides a reference for the further development and utilization of ES.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨芡实（Euryale ferox Salisb, ES）在预防和治疗糖尿病肾病（diabetic kidney disease, DKD）中的化学结构及作用机制。通过网络药理学方法，检索TCMSP、SymMap V2、CTD、DisGeNET和GeneCards数据库，获取ES成分、靶点及DKD靶点，以识别药物与疾病的共同靶点。采用PPI分析鉴定核心基因，随后进行DKD临床相关性、GO、KEGG分析及转录因子预测。最后进行分子对接。我们发现了ES的24种成分和72个靶点，其中9个具有临床相关性，主要受HNF4A和PPARG等转录因子调控。这些靶点主要参与信号转导、炎症反应、TNF调控、细胞凋亡、MAPK及其他信号通路。主要成分为油酸，靶向PPARA、LPL、FABP1编码的蛋白，以及维生素E，结合MAPK1、TGFB1编码的蛋白。总体而言，该方法提供了一种有效策略，即ES主要通过油酸和维生素E，靶向PPARA、LPL、FABP1、MAPK1编码的蛋白，调控TNF、细胞凋亡、MAPK及其他信号通路，从而对抗DKD。实际应用：芡实（ES）因其药用和食用价值而广为人知。此外，ES含有多种营养成分，其药理特性，包括抗抑郁、抗氧化和抗糖尿病作用，已被众多研究广泛证实。本文通过网络药理学结合临床相关性分析和分子对接，探讨了ES治疗糖尿病肾病（DKD）的靶点及机制，从分子水平阐明了其作用机制，为ES的进一步开发利用提供了参考。
